name: codex-security-triage-finding-evals
description: Promptfoo evals for the Codex Security triage-finding skill

scripts.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm rebuild better-sqlite3 && pnpm --dir ../../sdk/typescript run build:evals
scripts.sastbench:prepare: pnpm run sastbench:install && pnpm run sastbench:hydrate
scripts.test:calibration: pnpm run test:dataset && pnpm run test:calibration-generate && pnpm run test:calibration-evidence && pnpm run test:calibration-hydrate
scripts.test:deterministic: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-app-surface-instructions.mts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-triage-io.mts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-intake-assertions.mts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-calibration-dataset.mts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-generate-calibration-tests.mts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-calibration-evidence.mts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-hydrate-calibration-repos.mts && node --experimental-strip-types sastbench/scripts/test-sastbench-lib.mts && node --experimental-strip-types sastbench/scripts/test-install-sastbench.mts && node --experimental-strip-types sastbench/scripts/test-hydrate-sastbench-repos.mts && node --experimental-strip-types sastbench/scripts/test-sastbench-result.mts && node --experimental-strip-types sastbench/scripts/test-promptfoo-native-harness.mts
scripts.test:sastbench: node --experimental-strip-types sastbench/scripts/test-sastbench-lib.mts && node --experimental-strip-types sastbench/scripts/test-install-sastbench.mts && node --experimental-strip-types sastbench/scripts/test-hydrate-sastbench-repos.mts && node --experimental-strip-types sastbench/scripts/test-sastbench-result.mts && node --experimental-strip-types sastbench/scripts/test-promptfoo-native-harness.mts
scripts.validate:calibration: pnpm run calibration:generate && PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_WAL_MODE=true promptfoo validate config -c ./promptfooconfig.calibration.yaml
scripts.eval: mkdir -p artifacts && PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_WAL_MODE=true promptfoo eval -c ./promptfooconfig.yaml -o ./artifacts/triage-finding-eval.json --no-cache --no-share
scripts.eval:smoke: mkdir -p artifacts && PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_WAL_MODE=true promptfoo eval -c ./promptfooconfig.yaml -o ./artifacts/triage-finding-eval-smoke.json --no-cache --no-share --filter-range 0:1
scripts.eval:calibration: pnpm run calibration:generate && pnpm run calibration:hydrate && mkdir -p artifacts && PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_WAL_MODE=true promptfoo eval -c ./promptfooconfig.calibration.yaml -o ./artifacts/triage-finding-calibration-eval.json --no-cache --no-share
scripts.eval:calibration:smoke: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/generate-calibration-tests.mts --case oss-dompurify-ghsa-v8jm-5vwx-cfxm --variant vulnerable --output artifacts/calibration-smoke.yaml && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/hydrate-calibration-repos.mts --case oss-dompurify-ghsa-v8jm-5vwx-cfxm --variant vulnerable && mkdir -p artifacts && PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_WAL_MODE=true promptfoo eval -c ./promptfooconfig.calibration-smoke.yaml -o ./artifacts/triage-finding-calibration-smoke.json --no-cache --no-share
